name: OpenClaw Replay
description: Records correlated OpenClaw hook transcripts and provides replay/report tooling.

captureEnabled.description: Explicitly enable developer raw callback capture. Env: OPENCLAW_REPLAY_CAPTURE_ENABLED.

sessionDir.description: Directory for correlated runtime hook transcript JSONL files. Env: OPENCLAW_REPLAY_SESSION_DIR.

sessionName.description: Optional fixed transcript basename. Env: OPENCLAW_REPLAY_SESSION_NAME.

debug.description: Enable replay-owned diagnostic logging only. Env: OPENCLAW_REPLAY_DEBUG.

collectionMode.description: Replay transcript content mode. Env: OPENCLAW_REPLAY_COLLECTION_MODE.

stdout.description: Whether to also print transcript records to stdout.
